rationale: Arginine methyltransferases are required for lymphocyte development and fitness, as PRMT1 and PRMT5 loss both impair T-cell proliferation and survival. A germline-level genetic deletion is the most complete and the most disruptive of the three manipulations, so the arm with the smallest CD8+ compartment is the knockout; small molecules given for three days rarely produce so large a shift in lineage proportions.
